# Changelog

## 2.3
- **Folders drop down**: tap any folder and its photos, videos and files appear right under it. Tick or untick each one without leaving the list.
- "Show more" loads big folders a page at a time; "Full screen" opens a folder on its own.
- Tapping a file gives a soft spring animation; duplicate copies are tagged **Copy**.

## 2.2
- **Free up space**: moves originals already saved in your library to Twinless Trash, each checked byte by byte first. Undo for 30 days.
- **Twinless Trash**: empty it to get space back, or put everything back.
- **Storage chart**: storage now vs after cleanup.
- **Weekly check**: scans while charging and alerts you about new duplicates.
- **Faster rescans**: files already checked are remembered.
- New progress screen with steps, speed, time left, and a different animation for each stage.

## 2.1
- Runs in the background: progress in notifications and Android 16 Live Updates, with Cancel.
- Smoother, iOS-style motion and a glowing animated progress bar.

## 2.0
- **Onefold is now Twinless**: new name, new icon, premium violet-pink design.
- New scanning animation: files stream through a scan beam.

## 1.4
- Pick single files: open a folder as a photo grid and tick or untick each file.

## 1.3
- Choose folders before saving, photo mosaic behind your results, animated background.

## 1.2
- All file types: videos, documents, audio, archives, APKs and more.
- Counter-check: every rescan confirms nothing was missed.
- WhatsApp backups and app data are protected.

## 1.1
- One-tap scan of the whole phone, new design.

## 1.0
- First version: exact duplicate photos, verified copies into one clean folder, full report.
